scope: Four character worlds: eight route panoramas, three midboss thresholds, four boss arenas; 45 separate depth layers and seven registered composites. Established real rooms and narrative illustrations are unchanged.

concepts.akari: A suspended office where the departing coworker's seat remains opposite hers; unsent letters form returning bridges, inverted offices and rain frame two umbrellas.
concepts.koharu: A never-ending fan livestream seen from audience balconies, connected to her bedroom; Rei is only on the stream screen, with its chat column.
concepts.rei: A celestial virtual broadcast stage for her own voice and favorite book, with three warm listener bays; no live-action filming rig.
concepts.mina: Three friends' real rooms connected by fragile return bridges; her ideal of bringing everyone home is held together with ribbons while her own route is incomplete.

runtime.route: Three independently scrolling alpha layers; late scenery crossfades after the midboss and accelerates to 1.45 times base speed. Mina intensifies from echo wave two.
runtime.midboss_and_boss: Three static registered layers, depth-weighted parallax from player movement.
runtime.reveal: All dream layers are replaced by the existing real room at the final reveal.

generation_history.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production parallax-layer ATLAS for Akari's early side-scrolling route in Refrain. Reference 1 is the established fantastical boss world we approach (upside-down office islands and folded-letter bridges); reference 2 is her real office, style/motif only. This route is an alluring quieter approach before the midboss, not the boss arena. STRICT ATLAS: exactly 1536x1536 SQUARE canvas divided into THREE equal full-width horizontal strips, each 1536x512 (3:1 aspect). No margins, no separator strokes, no labels. These strips will be cut and OVERLAID at the same coordinates in-game, not shown as a triptych. TOP THIRD y=0..511: fully OPAQUE far panorama of muted slate-blue rain clouds, distant tiny suspended office slabs, soft amber sunset under cloud, dark calm atmospheric gulf lower half. No close objects. MIDDLE THIRD y=512..1023: TRUE TRANSPARENT background, only midground suspended ordinary office window strips and modest folded-paper footbridges, warm occupied-looking but EMPTY office desks as silhouettes inside office slabs, at local y=50..190 and y=360..490, leave the broad local central band and large gaps fully transparent. BOTTOM THIRD y=1024..1535: TRUE TRANSPARENT background, only very close dark navy/ivory folded-letter ledges and a few ordinary umbrella/handrail silhouettes along bottom local y=430..512, plus sparse paper folds hanging from top local y=0..65; leave middle 70% completely transparent. Continuous left/right matching baselines, seamlessly horizontally repeating flat side-on panorama, no vanishing point at center. Different depths move left at different speeds, no exact duplicate object between layers. Quiet central gameplay band local y=110..380 every strip, no glowing specks, no figures, no text, no UI, no trees, no plants, no skyline. Premium 2D Japanese anime background paint matching reference. Beautiful angular silhouettes, restrained ivory and amber warmth in deep slate blue, no storm violence yet. IMPORTANT preserve actual alpha in empty portions of middle/bottom strips; no checkerboard or colored background drawn. All THREE equal strips on ONE square texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production parallax atlas for Japanese anime side-scrolling shooter Refrain, entering this character's idealized mental world. The reference supplies palette/story motifs, not a composition to duplicate. ONE SQUARE 1536x1536 texture containing EXACTLY THREE equal horizontal strips, each 1536x512, no borders/gutters/labels. TOP third is the complete OPAQUE FAR panorama only. MIDDLE third is an actual transparent MIDGROUND overlay. BOTTOM third is an actual transparent NEAR overlay. They will be cropped then OVERLAID, each strip same local camera/baselines. Top strip fills its entire rectangle. Middle and bottom have real alpha, not black/checkerboard/matte. STRICT side-scrolling layout: side-on lateral environment, horizontal repeating panorama with matching end lighting/heights, no central vanishing point, no huge hero focal landmark. All important detail at local top/bottom edges; middle local y=140..370 broadly quiet and low contrast. No people, no readable text, no UI, no particles/bright attack-like dots. Sophisticated clean painted anime architecture, clear large silhouettes, no repeated stock plants/bookcase/city skyline. Do not put the boss character in any strip. Design purposeful layers at different scales so they create real parallax; no baked foreground inside far. Detailed but controlled grayscale hierarchy so bullets remain visible.
Early route before midboss: welcoming endless fan-night, soft dusky lavender, mint and peach. FAR: distant curved audience terraces suspended across a violet cloudy dusk with low-contrast deep central air and a warm far horizon, no giant display. MID alpha: varied audience balcony islands, calendar-sheet canopy with blank grids and broad lilac/mint welcoming ribbons at top and bottom outer bands, broad transparent gaps. NEAR alpha: dark rounded balcony rail along bottom15%, one unlit penlight on edge, loose fabric ends at top10%. Not an actual singer stage or skyscraper city, no giant glowing moon.

Use case: compositing / stylized-concept. Produce ONE three-layer parallax ATLAS for Refrain, a Japanese anime shooter. EXACT layout: tall portrait canvas 1536x3072, divided into THREE equal full-width horizontal rectangles each 1536x1024 (3:2). No margins, labels or separators.
